themes.title: Transnational Recalibration Following MAGA Midterm Defeats
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's Republican Party losing control of the US Congress in the midterms has triggered a major wave of recalibration and anxiety across right-wing parties worldwide. Far-right leaders from the UK, Italy, Brazil, Argentina, Germany, and Norway are distancing themselves from Trump's foreign policy mistakes, assessing domestic political fallout, or issuing strict messaging controls to prevent collateral damage to their own movements.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Republicans lost control of Congress amid public dissatisfaction with foreign military escalation and economic pressures.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage publicly attacked Donald Trump's foreign policy performance, attempting to shield Reform UK from MAGA's defeat.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni issued strict orders to avoid commenting on Trump's defeat, while allies stressed Italy's right is distinct from MAGA.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Casa Rosada officials and Argentine media analyzed the fallout of Trump's defeat on Javier Milei's international alignment.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Bolsonaro allies in exile faced heightened political vulnerability and scrutiny following the loss of Republican congressional leverage.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Internal disputes escalated within the AfD regarding the party's strategic relationship with Trump post-midterms.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Sylvi Listhaug assessed the US election results, framing economic frustration as the key driver behind voter backlash.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders across Europe and Latin America continue to forge explicit populist alliances and engage in parallel diplomatic maneuvers outside standard multilateral channels. High-profile international visits, such as Javier Milei meeting Vox's Santiago Abascal in Madrid and Flávio Bolsonaro attending CPAC events in Mar-a-Lago, demonstrate deep operational alignment across borders.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei traveled to Madrid for bilateral talks with Vox leaders while using the Ibero-American Summit platform to denounce socialism.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal hosted Javier Milei in Spain to strengthen Vox's international ties ahead of upcoming general elections.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro joined high-level conservative network gatherings at Mar-a-Lago alongside key US right-wing figures.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's network maintained bilateral diplomatic planning and coordination with major British populist figures.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage pursued strategic meetings with European right-wing counterparts including Marine Le Pen in Paris.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in multiple nations are framing law enforcement actions, constitutional court clashes, and state archive releases as weaponized establishment attacks. High-stakes battles over judicial independence in Poland and Brazil, alongside espionage probes into Hungarian opposition figures and French court cases, highlight intense institutional conflict.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro faced intense legal scrutiny, threats of US deportation, and STF investigations following his stay in Florida.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS mounted aggressive parliamentary resistance over the Constitutional Tribunal dispute, accusing government forces of an unconstitutional coup.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The release of state security agent files caused intense political scandals and triggered prosecutor probes into opposition figures.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen continued to face legal jeopardy and potential ineligibility threats ahead of the 2027 presidential race.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The Federal Constitutional Court reviewed internal party expulsions and parliamentary misconduct amid state surveillance concerns.

themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements across Europe are escalating campaign activities, publishing major book manifestos, and making significant polling gains ahead of upcoming municipal and national elections. In Spain, France, Sweden, Norway, and Germany, populist parties are positioning themselves as ready for government power while challenging mainstream establishment options.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal launched pre-campaign rallies across Spain ahead of general elections, competing directly with the mainstream PP.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella and Marine Le Pen accelerated 2027 presidential planning, targeting business leaders and releasing policy manifestos.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson held major press conferences outlining SD's conditions for governing power and long-term prime ministerial ambitions.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP registered historic polling numbers up to 40%, triggering sharp opposition power struggles over right-wing leadership.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD maintained strong leads in national polls while breaking local municipal cordons sanitaires.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Populist and conservative parties are embedding 'national priority' principles into legislative fights, regional budget negotiations, and cultural policy debates. FromVox's budget demands in Spain to debates over Swedish identity and dress-code restrictions in the UK, right-wing platforms are prioritizing native preference and cultural nationalism.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox successfully incorporated explicit 'national priority' provisions into regional budget agreements in Aragón.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Party leadership engaged in public debate over strict citizenship rules and the core political criteria of Swedish identity.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella proposed constitutional amendments tightening social benefit access and pension validation rules.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK representatives pushed for strict bans on full-face coverings and demanded tougher border enforcement measures.
